description.zh: 排程描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一。
description.en: The description of the schedule. It must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters. The description must be unique within the instance.

description.zh: 排程结束工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd，不得早于StartDate。
description.en: The scheduled end date of the job, in yyyy-MM-dd format. It must not be earlier than StartDate.

description.zh: 排程每日结束工作时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59，不能早于StartTime。
description.en: The end time of the schedule each day, in 24-hour format. The value must be within the range of 00:00 to 23:59 and cannot be earlier than StartTime.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 排程名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一。
description.en: The schedule Name, which must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters. The Name must be Unique within the instance.
The unique identifier of the schedule.

description.zh: 排程开始工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The start date of the schedule, in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

description.zh: 排程每日开始工作时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59。
description.en: The start time of the schedule each day, in 24-hour format. The value must be within the range of 00:00 to 23:59.

The status of the schedule.

- **WORKING**: Enable.

- **STOP**: Disable.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为2。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 2 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-sound-code-schedule --schedule-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --name test --description test --status WORKING --start-time 00:00 --end-time 23:59 --start-date 2022-03-31 --end-date 2022-03-31 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateSoundCodeSchedule --region cn-hangzhou --Status WORKING --StartDate '2022-03-31' --Description test --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --EndTime '23:59' --StartTime '00:00' --ScheduleCode Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --EndDate '2022-03-31' --Name test
